The men during those days were responsible, honest, and hardworking men, who took care of their families and even sent money back home on a regular basis, to take care of their parents, other immediate, and extended family members. Certain people need to focus on their own people and try to figure out how to fix themselves, instead of trying to manipulate the minds of others by rewriting history and telling lies.
